text:
alex_support: customer reports SSE stream aborts mid-response when switching from 5G -> cafe WiFi, client sees 200 then connection closed, no final end marker, partial tokens billed. repro steps attached.

eng_jordan: got it. can you share the request id and client logs? are they using our JS SDK or a native SSE client? which region?

alex_support: req_0x9f12. client log excerpt:```net::ERR_INCOMPLETE_CHUNKED_ENCODING\nEventSource.onmessage: stream ended unexpectedly```
Using native iOS SSE wrapper (no Redwood SDK). repro: 1) start SSE on 5G, 2) toggle WiFi on, 3) ~5-15s later stream stops — observed 3/5 runs. region: us-west-2.

eng_jordan: thanks. two likely culprits: client abort on TCP teardown (RST) during network change, or carrier NAT rebinding breaking socket. do we emit keepalive comments frequently?

support_maya: by default we send SSE comment keepalive every 15s. if the client has a 20s idle watchdog in the library it can still race on socket-level teardown during ip switch. iOS handoff often generates RST.

platform_tom: @eng_infra_sam can you grep edge / lb logs for req_0x9f12 (tls conn id) and check client IPs and tcp flags? want to see if we saw immediate RST or a new connection mid-request.

eng_infra_sam: grepped logs: initial tcp from 100.68.12.4 -> accepted, then ~8s later new ip 172.58.3.9 for same client cert, TLS session closed with no app error. LB shows CTX: request returned 200 then connection EOF. no upstream 5xx. looks like client-side TCP close during NAT rebinding.

alex_support: customer asks whether partial delivery should be billable — they got charged and say the chat never finished on their app.

billing_rita: policy: billed for tokens that were generated and successfully sent to the client. in this case server emitted chunks up to EOF, so it's technically billable. we can offer one-off refund if they provide clear repro showing purely client-side network flip that aborted UI before user saw content.

eng_jordan: proposed remediation: 1) eng-infra add more explicit TCP/RST markers to request logs and tag billing events when a connection abort is detected so support can identify carrier handoffs quickly. 2) devex to publish SSE best-practices: enable client buffering + reconnect with resume token and exponential backoff, keepalives, and avoid immediate UI close on partial chunks. 3) support to offer provisional credit while we investigate.

platform_tom: i'll open infra ticket to expose an edge field "conn_close_type" (FIN|RST|IDLE) and correlate with request ids.

support_maya: in the short term advise customer: increase client keepalive, add client-side reconnect logic that requests a fresh stream and de-duplicates repeated tokens, and optionally upgrade to our SDK which handles simple resume patterns. :white_check_mark:

alex_support: I'll pass instructions and offer provisional credit per billing. customer asked for a reproducible mitigation they can implement today — sending the SDK suggestion and the keepalive tweak.

eng_jordan: action items summarized: eng-infra to add conn_close_type logging; devex to draft SSE reconnect/keepalive doc; support to process one-off credit if customer supplies mobile network trace; billing to confirm refund rules. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
